html:
A vast civil war in southern and central China from 1850 to 1864, led by Hong Xiuquan against the Qing dynasty. It was among the deadliest wars in history, with deaths usually put at 20 to 30 million.

Hong, a village teacher from Guangdong, failed the imperial examinations several times. After reading Christian tracts he came to believe he was the younger brother of Jesus, sent to destroy demons, meaning the Manchu rulers. His God Worshippers grew among the poor of Guangxi and rose in revolt in 1851, proclaiming the Heavenly Kingdom of Great Peace.

In 1853 they took Nanjing and made it their capital. They banned opium, foot binding and private property in theory, and separated men and women. But a bloody split among the leaders in 1856 weakened them.

The Qing struggled. New provincial armies raised by scholar officials such as Zeng Guofan and Li Hongzhang did most of the fighting, helped by Western officers. Nanjing fell in 1864. The war left the south ruined and power shifted to provincial leaders, who then launched the Self-Strengthening Movement.
sum: A vast civil war in southern and central China from 1850 to 1864, led by Hong Xiuquan against the Qing dynasty. It was among the deadliest wars in history, with deaths usually put at 20 to 30 million.
